use_cases: Primary navigation for mobile-first web applications with animated tooltips
Tab switching interface with visual feedback and spring animations
Bottom navigation bar for SaaS dashboards and single-page applications
Tool-based application menu with backdrop blur effects
ai_summary: A bottom navigation menu component featuring animated tooltips, backdrop blur glass-morphism styling, and spring-based motion transitions. Tracks active item state with dynamic tooltip positioning. Built with Framer Motion for smooth enter/exit animations. Suitable for mobile-first interfaces requiring accessible, visually polished navigation controls.
